name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain=animation, descriptor=spell_projectile_y_offset_table. Name correctly reflects purpose (per-frame vertical-rise offset sequence for the AoE spell projectile/spark flight animation) and data shape (a _table of bytes). No Ghidra address residue: the only numeric is the y-axis semantics, no hex suffix matching its own address (0x5202C). Datatype byte[25]/uint8[25] is reflected by '_table'; 25 is an extent, not appended to the name.
purpose: AoE spell projectile/spark vertical-rise (y) offset sequence for the 22-frame multi-target flight animation (lightning / missile-rain effects).
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths (@ 0x1DF58) copies the 25 bytes into a stack scratch (0x1DF69: MOV ECX,6; MOV ESI,0x5202C; REP MOVSD; MOVSB = 6 dwords + 1 byte = 25 bytes). For each enemy fx_iter (ESI) and frame (EBP, 0..21) it computes idx = (fx_iter % 4) + frame (0x1E089 MOV EDI,4; IDIV; 0x1E097 LEA EAX,[EDX+EBP]) then loads the byte: 0x1E09A MOVZX EAX, byte ptr [ESP+idx]; SUB EAX,3; IMUL EAX,EAX,0x1C8 -> contributes to the projectile y-coordinate added to the blit base. Index range 0..24 maps to all 25 entries. Values form a symmetric rise/fall profile (0x0F..0x00..0x0F).
element_semantics: Per (frame, sub-step) vertical-rise offset byte. Each element is read unsigned (MOVZX, stride 1), then biased by -3 and scaled by 0x1C8 to form a signed y displacement for the projectile/spark sprite blit. Index = (fx_iter%4) + frame, range 0..24.
comment_original_issue: Header line gave the wrong address '@ 0x0202C' (missing the leading 5); the real address is 0x5202C. All body details (copy width, MOVZX byte access, index range, 25-byte extent, next-symbol boundary at 0x52045) are accurate.
notes: Verified against live Ghidra: datatype byte[25]; xrefs only from fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths (READ @0x1DF75 + DATA base @0x1DF70), no writers -> const. Disassembly of the reader confirms src comment's cited addresses (0x1DF69/0x1DF70/0x1DF77 copy; 0x1E09A byte load; 0x1DFE5 CMP EBP,0x16 frame bound). Next symbol data_fd2_battle_damage_number_format_buffer @ 0x52045 (read by fd2_show_damage_number) fixes the 25-byte extent. src comment fixed (address typo); Ghidra plate was empty -> created concise plate from src conclusion.
